# loop-spec

loop-spec is a Claude Code plugin that turns a feature request into a verified
pull request through six program-checked phases: SPEC, PLAN, EXECUTE, VERIFY,
ITERATE, DELIVER. A model does the judgment; a Python program checks each
claimed exit against that phase's postconditions before advancing.

## Entry stubs

Each is a thin `SKILL.md` that locates and runs the program, then acts on the
file `LOOP_SPEC_NEXT` names.

- [skills/loop-spec/SKILL.md](skills/loop-spec/SKILL.md): the hub — entry list, where state lives, how to read a step/question/result file.
- [skills/cycle/SKILL.md](skills/cycle/SKILL.md): run SPEC through DELIVER on a new feature request or spec file.
- [skills/micro/SKILL.md](skills/micro/SKILL.md): the same six phases in one pass, for a small well-defined change.
- [skills/debug/SKILL.md](skills/debug/SKILL.md): reproduce a failure, find the cause, land a fix with a regression test.
- [skills/revise/SKILL.md](skills/revise/SKILL.md): address reviewer feedback on an already-open pull request.
- [skills/status/SKILL.md](skills/status/SKILL.md): show a run's phase, open question or step, budget, and result.
- [skills/spec/SKILL.md](skills/spec/SKILL.md), [plan](skills/plan/SKILL.md), [execute](skills/execute/SKILL.md), [verify](skills/verify/SKILL.md), [iterate](skills/iterate/SKILL.md), [deliver](skills/deliver/SKILL.md): resume one phase of an existing run by slug.

## The program

- [skills/loop-spec/program/loop_spec/](skills/loop-spec/program/loop_spec/): the whole implementation, stdlib-only Python >= 3.11. `controller.py` drives phases; `contract.py` invokes one implementation; `postconditions.py` checks a claimed exit; `steps.py`/`questions.py` are the worker and human handoffs; `schemas/` holds every product, envelope, and step shape.
- [skills/loop-spec/references/contract.md](skills/loop-spec/references/contract.md): the process contract — files, fields, exit codes, config, environment — for an implementer or a harness author.

## Roles

Bundled prompt bodies and result schemas under
[skills/loop-spec/roles/](skills/loop-spec/roles/): `spec-writer`, `planner`,
`plan-critic`, `implementer`, `code-reviewer`, `verifier`, `iterate-judge`,
`debugger`, `reviser`. A project or user may bind a different skill in a role's
place (`.loop-spec/config.json` or `LOOP_SPEC_ROLE_<ROLE>`); the result is still
checked against the bundled role's schema.

## Design docs

- [docs/loop-spec/ROADMAP-7.0.md](docs/loop-spec/ROADMAP-7.0.md): why 7.x is shaped this way, milestone by milestone.
- [docs/loop-spec/phase-interface-7.0.md](docs/loop-spec/phase-interface-7.0.md): the full route matrix and every postcondition's prose.
- [docs/loop-spec/migrating-6-to-7.md](docs/loop-spec/migrating-6-to-7.md): how-to for a 6.x consumer moving to 7.x.
- [docs/loop-spec/live-runs-7.0.md](docs/loop-spec/live-runs-7.0.md): which checklist case was shown by which recorded live run.

## Examples

- [examples/supervisor/](examples/supervisor/README.md): a reference supervisor driving one cycle to completion on the Claude Agent SDK, with no person in the loop. Not a supported surface; not run live.

## Rules an agent must not break here

- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): the rules a change to this repository must obey.
- Do not add a dependency to the shipped program; it is stdlib-only Python plus one bash launcher.
- Do not write an offline test for a whole cycle; model-driven behavior is shown by a live run, recorded in [docs/loop-spec/live-runs-7.0.md](docs/loop-spec/live-runs-7.0.md).
- A name not in [skills/loop-spec/references/contract.md](skills/loop-spec/references/contract.md#configuration-and-environment) or read directly by `os.environ.get` in the program's own source is not a control.
